sql.smartlist.get: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id
sql.smartlist.getById: select s.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where s.id = :id;
sql.smartlist.update: update flow.smartlist set name = :name, company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId, shared = :shared where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.getAvailableFields: select sf.*, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist_field sf inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where cot.company_id = :companyId order by sf.company_object_type_id, sf.name;
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFields: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, sf.name, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa inner join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where sfa.smartlist_id = :id and sfa.archived is not true order by sfa.display_order;
sql.smartlist.getAssignedFieldById: select sfa.id, sfa.smartlist_id, sfa.smartlist_field_id, sfa.custom_field_id, sfa.archived, sfa.display_order, sf.name, ot.object_type from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa inner join flow.smartlist_field sf on sf.id = sfa.smartlist_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = sf.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id where sfa.id = :id and sfa.archived is not true order by sfa.display_order;
sql.smartlist.deleteField: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.updateDisplayOrder: update flow.smartlist_field_assignment set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id;
